output.summary: Deciduous shrubs and small trees native to temperate regions of the Northern Hemisphere, with greatest diversity in North America. They bear mostly white spring flowers followed by red, purple or nearly black berry-like summer fruits. The fruits are edible raw and are also used in baked goods, jams and wine.
output.edibilityNote: Fruits are eaten raw and used in pies, muffins, jams and wine; Indigenous people and early western Canadian settlers harvested them.
